name: book
description: The Book's AI skills and agents: plan a feature, outline its API, raise a defect or a question, review a branch or a pull request, commit, ship, check the client's sources and carry them through the docs, fact-check the code against the FSD, keep the docs consistent and trim, track progress, write for a non-engineer, and set up or upgrade a Book. A project made from the Book boilerplate keeps its docs, settings, checks and guard in its own repository; this plugin carries the skills that work on them.
